title: Drunk Driver Plows Through Jersey Shore Boardwalk
description:
A man was arrested after allegedly driving onto the boardwalk in Belmar, New Jersey and nearly striking pedestrians before smashing into another car after returning to the road. Police took Jason Nagy, 44, into custody around 9 a.m. after multiple witnesses reported having to jump out of the way of the dangerous driver. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
